subject: Ops + Model deep-dive — 75-minute slot options & agenda
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhao <clara@clovr.com>, Amanda Lee <amanda@cloverleaf.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Ops + Model deep-dive — 75-minute slot options & agenda

Hi Clara / Amanda —

Thanks again for the productive discovery yesterday. Based on the topics we ran through (expected qps, data residency, KV cache behavior, and model selection tradeoffs), the right next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML infra + serving team. We want to:

- Walk your infra/architecture leads through a proposed serving topology
- Validate latency/throughput targets and sizing assumptions
- Surface any compliance/network constraints for a Private deployment
- Align on an evaluation plan and success metrics (cost / latency / quality)

Can you confirm attendee roles on your side? We recommend: engineering lead, infra/cloud lead, and one ML lead (if available).

Proposed slots (all times in PDT):
1) Tue May 21 — 10:00–11:15 (75m)
2) Wed May 22 — 13:00–14:15 (75m)
3) Thu May 23 — 09:00–10:15 (75m)

If none of those work, share two windows that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short draft agenda and a single-page pre-read that outlines the demo we’d run and the infra artifacts we’ll bring.

Prelim agenda (attached: tdx_agenda_v2.pdf):
- 0–10m: goals and success metrics
- 10–35m: infra topology + hosting options (hosted / dedicated / private)
- 35–55m: model variant tradeoffs & quantization impacts (Ben will cover)
- 55–65m: demo artifacts and evaluation plan
- 65–75m: open questions / next steps / mutual action plan

Next steps for you: confirm a slot and attendee roster. I’ll coordinate our engineers (Marissa — infra lead; Ben — model serving).

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: tdx_agenda_v2.pdf (Agenda), pre-reads.md (one-pager)

2) We need a short section on networking/firewall rules for Private deployment (IPs, egress patterns).

If you can confirm Wed May 22 10:00 PDT we’ll send calendar invites from our side and include Raj.
